title: Lab values
participation: We aim to make immersive experiences accessible and participatory, welcoming different abilities, perspectives, and ways of learning.
context: We begin with people and the physical, cultural, and social contexts that shape their experiences.
collaboration: We bring disciplines together to ask questions, share knowledge, and learn through making.
body:
### Accessibility and participation

We propose considering access from the beginning of a project, offering understandable alternatives, and inviting feedback from the people an experience is intended to serve.

### People and context

We propose approaching places, histories, and communities with care, acknowledging the perspectives and limits of our work.

### Learning across disciplines

We propose working through open exchange, constructive feedback, and clear recognition of each contributor’s work.
